signal-ranges.alt: Four panels. Direct contact: two touching cells joined by gap junction channels that small molecules pass through. Local: a signaling cell releases a local regulator that reaches nearby cells with receptors. Synaptic: a neuron releases neurotransmitter across a tiny synaptic cleft onto one target cell. Endocrine: a gland releases a hormone into a blood vessel, which carries it to a distant target cell with receptors, while a cell without the receptor does not respond.
